senses.gloss: = h. מָשָׁל, parable, witty saying, riddle, comparison; by-word.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:6">Targ. Prov. I, 6</cite> (some ed. <cite ref="M03076"><he>מתלאה</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 24:14">Targ. I Sam. XXIV, 14</cite> (Bxt. <he>מָתְלַיָּא</he>, v. <cite ref="M03024"><he>מָתוֹלָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 23:7">Targ. Num. XXIII, 7</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:1:12">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:20">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, end <he>מ׳ אמר</he> the proverb says; a. fr.

senses.gloss: plausible reason, v. אֲמַתְלָא. Y. Yoma III, end, 41ᵇ מצאו מ׳ לדבריהן offered good reason for their doing so.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:5:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᶜ</cite> bot.—Pl. <he>מַתְלִין</he>, <he>מַתְלַיָּא</he>, <he>מַתְלֵי</he>. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:1">Targ. Prov. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:22">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ מאיר בפירקיה הוה דריש</he> … <he>תילתא מ׳</he> R. M., when holding sessions, used to spend one third of the time on legal subjects, one third on homiletical preaching, and one third on parables (illustrating Biblical verses).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:2">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> <he>תלת מאוון דמ׳ וכ׳</he> three hundred parables on the fox; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 9:1">Targ. II Chr. IX, 1</cite> <he>מוֹתְלַוָון</he>.
